acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides: keep the NOTE, or amend DOGFOOD.md and refuse with a named remedy.
If amended, a test pins the refusal for a merged-forward base without an anchor.
body: Residual from PR #1533 (V1-2171, DCW-V0-171). With an anchor set, the refusal now names the base to rerun with. Without one, a merged-forward base only prints a NOTE before any pass, because DOGFOOD.md forbids an implicit anchor. Turning the NOTE into a refusal needs an owner amendment of that rule.
title: Should dogfood-change refuse a merged-forward base when no anchor is set? DOGFOOD.md's no-implicit-anchor rule currently allows only a NOTE
